Primarina handles Fighting and Dark types, while Garchomp deals with Incineroar. I should lead with Garchomp, but I might also consider leading with Rotom for additional coverage against Palafin.**Choosing Lineup Order**

If I lead with Primarina, it can threaten Garchomp with Moonblast, but it likely won't outspeed it. So, I think the best choice is to go with Garchomp, Rotom-Wash, and Primarina.
